name: Proxy Handoff for Premiere Pro
releaseNotes:
- October 27, 2026
- New: edit remotely on proxies only, then hand the project back on the server's raw footage.
- Pull proxies with "Pull proxies only" in VideoVault Connect and cut on them as if they were the footage.
- When you're done, open Window > Extensions > Proxy Handoff, press Check project, then Hand back to server.
- Every proxy clip is pointed at its raw file on the VideoVault Server in a copy of your project named with _SERVER. Your own project stays as it is.
- Clips whose raw file can't be found on the server are listed by name and left on their proxy.
- Clip sizes are not changed. Clips you scaled to fill the frame on a smaller proxy may need their size fixed once they open on the raw footage.
